title: Beehive hot-to-cold loader
description: Archival outcomes, active stages, backlog, read leases and Go process health. Detailed performance profiles remain separate.

panels.title: Target availability
panels.description: 1 means the last Prometheus scrape of /metrics succeeded. 0 means that scrape failed. No sample means the target is unknown, not healthy.

panels.title: Go process uptime
panels.description: Time since this process started. A restart resets it and does not include the previous process.

panels.title: Coordinate-only mode
panels.description: 1 means the process serves grants and receipts without creating archive jobs, late jobs, or deletions.

panels.title: Hot deletion enabled
panels.description: 1 means guarded hot deletion is allowed. Coordinate-only mode keeps this at 0.

panels.title: Hot retention
panels.description: Minimum age before a complete UTC day can be archived. Production uses 30 days (720h). Backlog can keep data hot longer.

panels.title: Build revision
panels.description: Version and VCS revision compiled into this process. A binary built without VCS metadata shows unknown. This is not the image digest.

panels.title: Milestones observed in selected window
panels.description: First ROUTED and COMPLETE milestones seen in this time range. ROUTED means the cold snapshot was activated. COMPLETE is a later outcome. Events from before scraping started, and the journal migration baseline, are not included.

panels.title: Last known job milestones
panels.description: Most recent ROUTED or COMPLETE time recorded for each mode. A missing or zero timestamp is hidden.

panels.title: Current jobs carrying errors
panels.description: Unfinished jobs whose saved state still has an error. This is the current set, not a count of past failed attempts.

panels.title: Failed or canceled attempt rate
panels.description: Rate of finished stage attempts that failed or were canceled. Waiting for a lease is excluded. The counter resets when the process restarts.

panels.title: Scheduler errors
panels.description: Rate of scheduler or journal selection errors since this process started. The counter resets on restart.

panels.title: Jobs by durable next-step state
panels.description: Jobs waiting at each saved state. The state names the next step, not a worker that is running it now.

panels.title: Executing attempts
panels.description: Stage attempts running now. The value returns to zero when the attempt finishes or the process restarts. Waiting for a lease is not an executing attempt.

panels.title: Active attempt age
panels.description: How long the current stage attempt has been running. Only in-progress attempts are shown. A long synchronous stage also pauses the scheduler heartbeat.

panels.title: Waiting jobs
panels.description: Jobs blocked now, split by writers, readers, deletion disabled, retry backoff, or coordinate-only. The count is rebuilt from the journal.

panels.title: Next retry
panels.description: When the next retry of a failed attempt is due. Hidden when nothing is scheduled.

panels.title: Oldest unfinished job age
panels.description: Age of the oldest job that has not finished. Hidden when no unfinished job exists or its creation time was not recorded.

panels.title: Cold routing frontier
panels.description: Exclusive boundary between cold and hot data. A query at or after this time still reads Influx. This is not the time Influx has deleted.

panels.title: Retention-adjusted routing lag
panels.description: How far the frontier sits behind the hot-retention deadline. Zero means it is inside that window. Scheduling by whole UTC days can add up to one day. This is not deletion lag.

panels.title: Pending late records
panels.description: Late corrections accepted into the inbox and not yet finished. This is not a count of late points still stored in Influx.

panels.title: Oldest pending late record age
panels.description: Age of the oldest unfinished late-inbox record. Zero means the inbox has nothing pending.

panels.title: Quarantine records
panels.description: Records held for investigation. This is the current population, not the number quarantined during the selected time range.

panels.title: Average observed attempt duration
panels.description: Mean wall time of stage attempts that finished in this window. No finished attempts means no value. The samples reset when the process restarts.

panels.title: Attempt samples in selected window
panels.description: Stage attempts that finished in this window. Use this count before trusting the average or p95 of a sparse stage.

panels.title: Observed attempt duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of finished attempt wall time, estimated from histogram buckets. A small sample count does not establish a reliable tail.

panels.title: Pending hot deletions
panels.description: Archive jobs routed for hot deletion, or already deleting. A non-zero value is expected while deletion is off or readers are still draining.

panels.title: Writer permits and expired rows
panels.description: Active writer permits, including the one-minute drain after expiry, still block archival. Expired rows no longer block it. Unacknowledged broker deliveries are recovered by redelivery.

panels.title: Reader leases including grace
panels.description: Read grants that still block hot deletion, including the one-minute drain after expiry.

panels.title: Expired unreleased reader rows
panels.description: Read grants kept for diagnosis after expiry and the drain grace. They no longer block deletion.

panels.title: Profile files removed
panels.description: Performance-profile files deleted by retention in this time range. Journals, catalogs, receipts, and verification evidence stay. The counter resets on restart.

panels.title: Profile maintenance errors
panels.description: Profile-cleanup passes that failed in this time range. A failure does not change a job outcome and does not allow hot deletion.

panels.title: Last successful profile maintenance
panels.description: Time of the last profile cleanup that succeeded. Hidden until the first success.

panels.title: Go process CPU
panels.description: CPU time per second for this Go process. DuckDB, influxd, and the container total are not included.

panels.title: Go process resident memory
panels.description: Resident memory of this Go process. DuckDB and influxd memory are outside this value.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Goroutines in this Go process. A count that rises and stays high can mean work that did not return. It is not the container thread count.

panels.title: Average Go garbage collection pause
panels.description: Mean Go garbage-collection pause for this process. It is not query latency and not DuckDB time. No completed collections means no value.

panels.title: API reader lease renewal (separate API targets)
API target availability
panels.description: 1 means Prometheus scraped the selected API target. These panels use the API job and instance filters. The renewal series exist only on an API build that emits them.

panels.title: API renewal outcomes
panels.description: Rate of read-lease renewals finished by the API: success, error, or canceled. A failure can happen before the coordinator accepts the renewal. The counter resets when the API restarts.

panels.title: Average API renewal latency
panels.description: Mean time the API spent on a background read-lease renewal. This is not query duration. No completed renewals means no value.

panels.title: API renewals observed in selected window
panels.description: Renewals the API finished in this time range, by outcome. Counts begin at the first scrape and reset when the API restarts.

options.content:
[beehive-hot-to-cold-loader](https://github.com/waggle-sensor/beehive-hot-to-cold-loader) on GitHub. Metric names and alert rules are in `docs/metrics.md` in that repository.

The Prometheus datasource is chosen when this dashboard is imported. Loader panels always use job `beehive-hot-to-cold-loader`. **Instance** selects pod targets of that job. One Ready replica is one target.

**Mode** applies only to panels whose metric has a mode label. `archive` is a day moving from Influx to the warehouse. `late` is a correction for a day already behind the frontier.

**API job** and **API instance** apply only to the API reader lease renewal row. Those series come from the data API scrape, not from the coordinator.

A missing sample is shown as Unknown. That is not a zero backlog, and it is not proof that the service is down.

Coordinate-only mode serves grants and receipts. It does not create archive jobs, late jobs, or deletions. The cold routing frontier is the exclusive boundary between cold and hot queries. It is not the time Influx has deleted. Retention lag measures how far that frontier sits behind the hot-retention deadline.

Go CPU, resident memory, goroutines, and garbage-collection time are this process only. DuckDB and influxd are outside those values.

Stage attempts, scheduler errors, and profile cleanup are process-local counters. They reset when the process restarts. Milestone counts include only events scraped inside the selected time range.

Pending late records are unfinished inbox corrections, not late points still stored in Influx. Profile cleanup removes performance profiles only. Journals, catalogs, receipts, and verification evidence stay.

Archive jobs advance oldest-first through durable stages. A state names the **next** work to perform, not a worker that is running it now. Only complete UTC days ending at or before `now - hot retention` are eligible. Failed work stays recoverable. `ROUTED` means cold data is queryable; it does not mean the hot copy has been deleted. Late jobs finish at `ROUTED` without hot deletion. Full detail: [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/waggle-sensor/beehive-hot-to-cold-loader/blob/main/docs/architecture.md).

| State | Work before advancing |
| --- | --- |
| `FENCING` | Wait for writer permits covering the day to release or expire plus drain grace. New writes to the fenced day become late receipts. |
| `EXPORTING` | Export the source engine into primitive local Parquet, retaining replay sequence. |
| `EXPORTED` | Normalize overwritten identities and prove equality against an independent Influx query. |
| `RECONCILED` | Materialize expected rows, pack the warehouse layout, and verify the build. |
| `BUILT` | Publish files and commit an Iceberg snapshot; recognize an already committed job on retry. |
| `COMMITTED` | Read back remote objects and perform fresh exact verification. |
| `REMOTE_VERIFIED` | Activate the snapshot and advance contiguous coverage atomically in the control journal. |
| `ROUTED` | For an archive job, wait for deletion enablement and old readers. Late jobs finish here without hot deletion. |
| `DELETING` | Reverify the published data on every destructive attempt, then request the hot interval deletion. |
| `DELETE_REQUESTED` | Query the interval to confirm it is empty; retry through `DELETING` if needed. |
| `COMPLETE` | Persist completion and clean eligible local scratch. |
